messages:
Sam (AE): Quick sync 10: Renewal negotiation for MeadowBank. They ran a small POC and now want a 36-month term with 30% off list and custom SLA. They also asked for a credit for POC months.
Nina (CS): They used Hosted during POC but plan to move to Dedicated. Usage pattern is spiky 10 morning batch jobs + afternoon interactive.
Ravi (SE): POC infra: 2xA10G, average seq 4k. We saw cache miss on certain queries 10 suggest prefix caching and a `max_cache_items` bump.
Sam (AE): MeadowBank insists on a written comms that Dedicated nodes will run in-region only. Legal + infra confirm?
Pri (Legal): Need to check data residency in MSA. We typically allow region control but must confirm with cloud providers. Also, 36 months + 30% off likely exceeds standard concessions.
Jules (Deal Desk): 30% + 36mo is outside normal ranges. Two options: 1) 15% + upfront 6 months free; 2) 22% with annual true-up and usage-floor. Which works from CS?
Nina (CS): Option 2 is dangerous ops-wise unless they put a firm capacity reserve. Option 1 preferrable for predictable provisioning.
Luke (Finance): If they prepay 6 months we can allow up to 18% concession. 30% needs exec pricing approval.
Ravi (SE): Technical asks: dedicated audit streaming to their SIEM, cross-account IAM role for log access, and a canary rollback path. We'll need 7 days to prepare runbook.
Sam (AE): Also they're requesting a clause for termination assistance: 90-day export with support. Pri, legal ok?
Pri (Legal): Export assistance ok, but cap support hours and include egress fee pass-through. Drafting changes.
alerts-bot: Due to scheduled infra upgrade next week, provisioning ETA may extend to 21 days for new Dedicated clusters.
Jules (Deal Desk): I'll model both options and flag if VP approval needed. Provide ARR estimate so I can calc blended margin.
Sam (AE): ARR estimate: `$360k` annualized at list. With 30% it's `$252k`.
Luke (Finance): Sharing ARR model and margin floor. If they prepay 12 months we can safely offer 20% without exec sign-off.
Sam (AE): Ok team, let's prep runbook, legal redlines, and a quote before the customer meeting Friday. Thanks.
